title.rendered: FTS Mod PES 2020 Apk Obb Data Download

content.rendered:
Download FTS Mod PES 2020 Apk Obb Data for Android with high Quality Graphics and latest transfers update.

PES 2020 Mod FTS is just 300 MB in size which runs smoothly on all kinds of Android device, be it Android OS 4.1.

The First Touch Soccer Mod PES has some new features ported from the PES soccer game for Android, such as faces, kits, logos and many more.

Game play control buttons are now easy to use with PlayStation logo, which doesn’t hangs when playing with your favourite teams.

In the new FTS Mod PES 2020 game for all Android users, new teams have added with full player transfers, other leagues such as Premier league, champions league have been updated with new promo banners etc.

New stadiums have been added, you can select from the newly developed stadiums, which serve as your home stadium to host competitions and normal matches.

Manager mode is also fully working with redesigned panel to help you manage players and check there overall performance, you can also get latest updates on how your team performed in the last match and know your current position on the table.

FTS Mod PES 2020 transfer market is always available for you to buy and sell new players easily without any restrictions.

In other to sell and buy new players, FTS Mod 2020 PES comes with unlimited amount of Coins or money, you can also use it to unlock other items.

You can switch to any language of your choice by going to First Touch Soccer Mod PES 2020 settings and swipe from left to right.

Download FTS Mod PES 2020 Apk + Obb + Data For Android

You will get the link to download First Touch Soccer Mod PES 2020 (FTS Mod PES) which includes Apk, Obb and Data necessary to install the soccer game on your Android phone.

Apk

FTS Mod PES 2020 Apk   

Data

Data FTS Mod PES 20

Obb

  FTS Mod PES 20 Obb

How To Install 

Follow the steps below to easily install FTS Mod PES 2020 Apk, Obb and Data on your Android phone.

The steps are:

  1. Download zarchiver App to extract all the files above by following instructions in the steps below.
  2. Click on FTS 20 Mod PES Obb Rar file.
  3. Option menu will come up, click “Extract”.
  4. Navigate or go to phone memory or Device Memory.
  5. Now click on Android folder and further click obb folder.
  6. Click “Extract Icon” which looks like a arrow pointing downwards, obb file will be successfully extracted after some minutes.
  7. Similarly, click Data FTS 20 Mod Pes Rar file and go to Android folder and open data folder, also click extract icon to extract data file.
  8. Finally Install Apk and start playing.
